title.narrative: UNICEF supported the government to enhance the capacity of social protection systems through the integration of cash interventions into areas like health, nutrition, education, and child protection. The Nutrition Improvements through Cash and Health Education (NICHE) program reached about 63,450 beneficiaries by November 2024 which was a positive increase from the 32,879 households reported in the previous reporting period. Through UNICEF support, an additional 696,447 beneficiary households were registered and enrolled (as of August 2024), raising the total coverage of the Inua Jamii cash transfer programs from 1.028 million to 1.703 million households. UNICEF facilitated the registration of 576 children with the National Council for Persons with Disabilities (NCPWD) of which 370 (211 M, 159F) children received assistive devices.
